issue_context.title: Bug: Duplicate Display Issue with Pinned Directories in the Favorites Bar in the Quick Access Home Page
issue_context.body: ### Description Hello, I have noticed an issue where any directory I pin to the Favorites bar in the sidebar on the Quick Access Home Page is displayed as a duplicate entry. ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Right-click on a folder 2. Click on "Add to Favorites" ### Requirements Identify the cause of the duplicate display issue for pinned directories in the Favorites bar. ### Files Version Version : 2.4.82.0 ### Windows Version Windows 11 22H2 22621.1702 ### Log file
comments: @Lukiluc29 this issue should be resolved in v2.5.
